scenario: `s !~ /pattern/` fires when the string does NOT match per LREG.1.3. Pin: assert user `alice` (matches `/^admin/` → does not fire) and user `bob` (doesn't match → fires). One fire.
rules_ds:
schema User scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    name: String mutable

rule non_admin:
    User u where u.name !~ /^admin/
->
    log info "non-admin"
